acceptance: At fleet.orchestrator.admission enforce, a lane admitted only by the optimistic (shared-edit) rule carries its would-be holder to the ship (red test first)
A composed-gate failure or rebase conflict of such a lane publishes one signal with todo, holder and gate
The rate is readable for one wave (evolve wave status or the wave record)
fix: TDD first (red test before code), 100% coverage on new and changed functions, zero comments, the package note and the spec updated; do not change the composed-tree gate itself.
routed_reason: the ship-side record touches the ship phase and the orchestrator; plan wave-latency-2026-10 routes W1b to the console before W2
source: W1 follow-up PR review (#996 architecture-reviewer finding 1), plan wave-latency-2026-10 W1b
summary: W1 (lane cycle ca763e7c2 plus its follow-up) built the admission half of plan wave-latency-2026-10 D2: fleet.orchestrator.admission (default shadow), admission.Admitter.Optimistic and LOOP_ORCH_ADMISSION_SHADOW. At shadow a freed candidate never runs beside its holder, so the D3 failure rate cannot be measured there. W1b: mark each lane that only the optimistic rule admitted (at fleet.orchestrator.admission enforce), and at its ship record each rebase conflict or composed-tree gate failure against the lane that the reach rule would have held it behind. W2 (the move to enforce) waits for W1b; above one in five failures in the first enforce wave the key goes back to shadow.
title: Wave latency W1b: the ship records a composed-gate failure between two lanes that only the optimistic admission rule admitted (ADR-0143 D2)
